_comment: Per-account settings for Null's Addons. 'budget' is used when running offline / without an API key; pass --live with a Hypixel key to override it with the account's real purse + bank. Set 'cookie_buffed': true if a Booster Cookie is active (lowers Bazaar tax 1.25% -> 1.1%).
